fields.name: num_frames
fields.title: Number of Frames
fields.description: Number of frames to generate. Must be between 17 to 161 (inclusive).

fields.name: frames_per_second
fields.title: Frames per Second
fields.description: Frames per second of the generated video. Must be between 4 to 60. When using interpolation and `adjust_fps_for_interpolation` is set to true (default true,) the final FPS will be multiplied by the number of interpolated frames plus one. fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

fields.name: resolution
fields.title: Resolution
fields.description: Resolution of the generated video (480p, 580p, or 720p).

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.title: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. If 'auto', the aspect ratio will be determined automatically based on the input image.

fields.name: num_inference_steps
fields.title: Number of Inference Steps
fields.description: Number of inference steps for sampling. Higher values give better quality but take longer.

fields.name: enable_output_safety_checker
fields.title: Enable Output Safety Checker
fields.description: If set to true, output video will be checked for safety after generation.

fields.name: enable_prompt_expansion
fields.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
fields.description: Whether to enable prompt expansion. This will use a large language model to expand the prompt with additional details while maintaining the original meaning.

fields.name: acceleration
fields.title: Acceleration
fields.description: Acceleration level to use. The more acceleration, the faster the generation, but with lower quality. The recommended value is 'regular'.

fields.name: guidance_scale
fields.title: Guidance Scale (1st Stage)
fields.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Higher values give better adherence to the prompt but may decrease quality.

fields.name: guidance_scale_2
fields.title: Guidance Scale (2nd Stage)
fields.description: Guidance scale for the second stage of the model. This is used to control the adherence to the prompt in the second stage of the model.

fields.name: shift
fields.title: Shift
fields.description: Shift value for the video. Must be between 1.0 and 10.0.

fields.name: interpolator_model
fields.title: Interpolator Model
fields.description: The model to use for frame interpolation. If None, no interpolation is applied.

fields.name: num_interpolated_frames
fields.title: Number of Interpolated Frames
fields.description: Number of frames to interpolate between each pair of generated frames. Must be between 0 and 4.

fields.name: adjust_fps_for_interpolation
fields.title: Adjust FPS for Interpolation
fields.description: If true, the number of frames per second will be multiplied by the number of interpolated frames plus one. fields.name: video_quality
fields.title: Video Quality
fields.description: The quality of the output video. Higher quality means better visual quality but larger file size.

fields.name: video_write_mode
fields.title: Video Write Mode
fields.description: The write mode of the output video. Faster write mode means faster results but larger file size, balanced write mode is a good compromise between speed and quality, and small write mode is the slowest but produces the smallest file size.
